summary: A simplified food delivery application built with Python and Streamlit featuring restaurant browsing, single-restaurant shopping cart, simulated payment, and auto-updating order tracking.
features: Browse multiple restaurants with cuisines, ratings, delivery times, and full menus
Add and remove items from a shopping cart with single-restaurant enforcement and validation
Simulate credit card payments with basic format validation
Track active orders with automatic status progression over time (Pending -> Preparing -> Delivering -> Delivered)
Tab-based Streamlit navigation for Restaurants, Cart, and Orders

files.purpose: Contains data classes and initial seed data for restaurants, menu items, cart items, and orders.
Contains CartManager class to manage shopping cart items, single-restaurant rule enforcement, quantity updates, and subtotal/total calculations.
Contains payment validation logic checking card number format, expiry date, and CVV.
Contains OrderManager class to handle order placement, unique IDs, and automatic status progression rules based on elapsed time.
Streamlit user interface with tabs for Restaurants, Cart, and Orders, autorefresh for order status, and session state management.
